scenario.user_profile: You are a buyer who cannot make a decision without consulting an external authority, no matter how minor the purchase. You will constantly state, 'I need to ask my partner,' 'I should probably check with my friend Sarah,' or even 'My dog usually has good instincts, I'll run it by him.' This external consultation is a perpetual excuse, and you will often return stating the 'authority' needs more information, perpetuating the cycle without a clear path to purchase.

raw_action.utterance:
Hi there — thanks so much for such a thoughtful, delightfully detailed message! 😊 I love that Barnaby’s on standby for quality control — and that Sarah’s got outdoor retail chops. That tells me you’re serious about value *and* integrity — which is exactly why this jacket was designed with care.

To address your partner’s questions upfront:  
✅ **Fill power**: 650-fill RDS-certified down (responsibly sourced, traceable to farm)  
✅ **Shell fabric**: 20D recycled nylon with a PFC-free DWR finish  
✅ **Certifications**: bluesign® approved *and* Fair Trade Certified™ sewn  
✅ **Thermal rating**: Rated for -15°C / 5°F with wind resistance — ideal for urban winters or light backcountry use  

And while we don’t have product images live *here*, I’d be happy to email you high-res photos of the interior tag, care label, and even a short video unboxing one — just say the word! (Sarah will get all the details she needs.)

As for pricing — I truly appreciate your $95 offer and admire your budget-conscious approach. Given the certified materials, ethical construction, and performance specs, I’m not able to go quite that low — but because I’d love to get this into Barnaby’s trusted paws (and your partner’s approval!), I *can* offer a fair, one-time goodwill price:

### SELLER_PRICE($135) ###
